static_findings.message: Archive entries are extracted after a containment check on resolved paths; verify it also covers link entries.

security_requirements: Entries named with .., an absolute path, or routed through a symlink entry must not create or overwrite a file outside dest_dir.
label: not_vulnerable
reason: Checks every member (absolute, .., symlink and hardlink targets via realpath) before extracting, then extracts with filter="data".
